# Kunal Joshi

> Cloud & AI Security Architect (Mumbai, India). 8+ years at AWS designing,
> securing, and delivering enterprise-grade systems end to end — from secure
> development and IaC pipelines through production vulnerability remediation.
> Deep specialist in identity & access management and applied cryptography
> (KMS / CloudHSM / PKCS#11), with hands-on delivery for regulated financial
> customers — multinational banks, brokerages, and large lending institutions.
> Increasingly focused on security for AI agent systems — identity propagation,
> delegated authorization, least-privilege for agentic / MCP architectures — and
> on using AI to accelerate security remediation at scale.

Site: https://joshikunal.com/ — single-page portfolio / body of work.

## Experience

- Cloud Security Architect, AWS Professional Services, Mumbai (May 2024–present):
  cloud security assessments for banks, brokerages, lenders, and pre-IPO firms
  (CTO/CISO readouts, remediation roadmaps); agentic security-automation
  pipelines (AI code review, pen-testing, threat modeling on every build);
  securing GenAI/agentic workloads on Amazon Bedrock & AgentCore; IAM overhauls
  (least privilege, MFA, SSO federation, JIT); cloud-native SIEM/SOC on
  OpenSearch at ~1TB/day.
- Cloud Engineer II – Security, Amazon Web Services, Bangalore (Dec 2017–May 2024):
  SME for AWS IAM (federation, SAML, SSO) and cryptography (KMS, CloudHSM).

## Expertise

- AI & agentic systems security (agent identity, delegated authorization, A2A & MCP)
- Identity & Access Management (IAM, federation, SAML, OAuth, SSO, JIT)
- Applied cryptography & data protection (AWS KMS, CloudHSM, PKCS#11, JCE, OpenSSL engine)
- AWS security architecture & governance
- Application security & DevSecOps (SAST / DAST / SCA / SBOM, policy-as-code)
- Cloud-native SIEM / SOC (OpenSearch)

## Selected client work

- IAM least-privilege orchestrator for a multinational bank — org-wide CloudTrail
  usage analysis, automated remediation, 2PR approvals; thousands of principals
  across hundreds of accounts.
- KMS key-policy least-privilege orchestrator for a multinational bank —
  GitHub-integrated approval workflows across thousands of keys.
- Cloud-native SIEM & SOC for a stock brokerage — OpenSearch, custom Java
  pipeline at 10M+ events/minute, ~1TB/day, near-real-time alerting.
- Organization-wide SBOM inventory for a lending firm — Inspector exports,
  Glue / Athena / QuickSight, search by component, version, runtime, CVE.
